title: Valid Emergency With Excessive Scope
request_text: A windstorm damaged the roof of the community center, allowing water to enter the building. Additional rain is forecast within three days. Facilities requests emergency authorization for a complete roof replacement. The proposed work also includes upgraded insulation, installation of new skylights, replacement of undamaged gutters, and repainting portions of the exterior.
